liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **In The Midnight Hour** (2 reviews, 2 other sources): Santana takes a strong solo that spurs Jerry's own solo; reviewer recommends playing it loud; Reviewer says this one sizzled and is the only reason to download the show [1][6][10][11]
- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl** (2 reviews): Judged decent, though outshone by the Midnight Hour that followed; Reviewer says the song had gone unplayed for 17 years, and Carlos and the band tore into it [11][19]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): Opening song finds Jerry sounding a bit weak, with the rest of the band compensating [18]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Has muscle, but Bobby's slide solo is judged nearly terrible [18]
- **Tons Of Steel** (1 review): Brent calls it after about 90 seconds of silence; reviewer likes its carefully designed ending [18]
- **The Other One** (1 other source): Track starts when Phil enters just before the first verse; Jerry and Bob jammed around it beforehand [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl**: back after 1189 archived shows (6181 days) [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-08-22.142138.sbd.ultramatrix.betaHiFi.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-08-22.142146.UltraMatrix.sbd.bm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 157 min [3]
- **gd1987-08-22.151076.fob.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd87-08-22.sbd.barbella.4795.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 149 min; rated 3.75/5 by 16 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound good [13]
- **gd1987-08-22.149781.aud.flac1644**: audience recording; 20 songs; 136 min [9]. Said about its sound: On Bird Song the taper panics over a seemingly dead level meter; levels audibly swing wildly [9]

## Around the show

- Carlos Santana sat in with the band at this show and played the following night as well [10]
- Reviewer found the show soft until Carlos joined on stage, after which the energy rose [11]
- Santana's own opening set before the Dead was stellar, and the reviewer wants a copy of it [12]
- Santana joins for Schoolgirl and Midnight Hour, lifting a show that otherwise lacked energy; second set lacks momentum [13]
- Reviewer attended on a very hot day; an air show took place before any music [17]
- Skydivers appeared before the band; the last one unfurled a Stealie flag and landed behind the stage [19]
- Reviewer was thrilled to see Carlos play with the band but could not stay for the next day [19]
- Reviewer worked for BGP and recalls a beautiful venue and weather that week [21]
- Reviewer hears the band gaining steam ahead of the East Coast run, with a strong first set [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-08-22.142138.sbd.ultramatrix.betaHiFi.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Beta HiFi Master (Sony Betamax/TDK HS) [1]. Also: Soundboard source labeled UltraMatrix, betaHiFi, from Miller, in 24-bit FLAC [1]
- **gd1987-08-22.142146.UltraMatrix.sbd.bm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Beta HiFi Master (Sony Betamax/TDK HS) [3]. Also: UltraMatrix soundboard file set, 16 bit at 44.1 [3]
- **gd1987-08-22.151076.fob.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [6]. Also: The ultramatrix source supplies a 28-second patch in Space; Other One space is included in that track [6]
- **gd87-08-22.sbd.barbella.4795.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Master PCM> DAT> CDR> EAC> first shn by Tony Gardner> misc flaw fixes by Steve Barbella (see info file)> reshn (nonseeking) [8]
- **gd1987-08-22.149781.aud.flac1644**: taped by Anon; transferred by Anon; source: Location: right of center FOB; Gear: unknown stero mic (in hat) > Sony WMD6C (Maxell XLII); [9]. Also: Audience recording with a tape flip between Drums and Space [9]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Calaveras County Fairgrounds - August 22, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/august-22-1987) [23]
